stops.name: Staubbachfall
stops.quote: Its landmark is the Staubbachfall: see how it cascades 300 metres over the vertical rock face.
stops.english: Its landmark is the Staubbachfall: see how it cascades 300 metres over the vertical rock face.

stops.name: Trümmelbachfälle
stops.quote: The Trümmelbachfälle also lets you feel the tremendous energy of the water: the glacier water thunders through a labyrinth of rocks inside the mountain.
stops.english: The Trümmelbachfälle also lets you feel the tremendous energy of the water: the glacier water thunders through a labyrinth of rocks inside the mountain.

stops.name: Mürrenbachfall
stops.quote: The Mürrenbachfall, which plunges 750 meters into the depths in five cascades, is a mighty sight.
stops.english: The Mürrenbachfall, which plunges 750 meters into the depths in five cascades, is a mighty sight.

stops.name: Wengen
stops.quote: Then the best photo spot can be found in the car-free postcard village Wengen.
stops.english: Then the best photo spot can be found in the car-free postcard village Wengen.

stops.name: Männlichen
stops.quote: The trip up to the Männlichen is worth the ride alone – on the roof of the cable car.
stops.english: The trip up to the Männlichen is worth the ride alone – on the roof of the cable car.

stops.name: Mürren
stops.quote: From Mürren the cable car takes you up to Schilthorn with its revolving restaurant Piz Gloria.
stops.english: From Mürren the cable car takes you up to Schilthorn with its revolving restaurant Piz Gloria.

stops.name: Kleine Scheidegg
stops.quote: Depending on what takes your fancy at the time, either take the cogwheel railway to Kleine Scheidegg or the cable car to Mürren.
stops.english: Depending on what takes your fancy at the time, either take the cogwheel railway to Kleine Scheidegg or the cable car to Mürren.
